corrections.detail: Astra now requires exact provider=openai and native Astra authority profile, then unconditionally validates native response hash, model/status/error/incomplete state, tier, usage, visible output, actual regular nonsymlink image bytes, and reconstructed request-body digest. Original foreign-profile and missing-profile reproductions both reject. Final builder passes its actual page image to this validator; retained receipt consumption also supplies actual image before accepting/appending the record.

Literal source and common OCR native requests now explicitly request service_tier=default, matching frozen request construction. The guard rejects omitted or nondefault requested tier; original omitted-tier reproduction rejects. Successful Astra responses missing/contradicting default tier cannot settle at standard rates: ledger closes and full unknown reservation remains. Transient502 without a tier retains unknown exposure and remains eligible only for the preauthorized single recovery gate.

SourceOnlyReader uses responses.with_raw_response.create, retains returned content and digest before native.parse, and carries the original UTF8 bytes in portable native_response_json. No model_dump_json fallback remains. Campaign guard writes exact request.content with a separate native-byte hash while retaining canonical body digest for frozen admission. Need connected proof to establish portable report bytes equal actual guarded response files on both arms.
